emails.subject: URGENT: Temperature Excursion - DNL593 Study - Site 105
emails.body:
Hi Alex,

Hope you are well.

This morning we discovered a temperature excursion in the investigational product refrigerator at our pharmacy. The excursion occurred overnight.

- Study: DNL593
- Site: 105 - UCSF Medical Center
- Excursion Start: Approx. 2023-10-25 22:00 PST
- Excursion End: 2023-10-26 06:00 PST
- Recorded Min/Max Temp: -1.5°C / 9.5°C (storage range is 2-8°C)
- Affected Product: All DNL593 and placebo vials currently in stock.

I have attached the continuous temperature monitoring log for your review. Please advise on the next steps and whether the product integrity may be compromised. The stock is currently being held in the fridge, but we have not used any for dispensing this morning.

Best regards,

Sarah Miller, RPh
Pharmacist
UCSF Medical Center Pharmacy

emails.subject: Fwd: URGENT: Temperature Excursion - DNL593 Study - Site 105
emails.body:
Hi David,

Please see the urgent notification below from Site 105 regarding a temperature excursion for the DNL593 IP. Can you please assess the attached temperature log and advise on the product's viability?

Sarah/Maria - Thank you for the prompt notification. Please quarantine all affected DNL593 and placebo vials immediately. Do not dispense any of this stock. Please label it clearly as 'QUARANTINED - DO NOT USE' and move it to a separate, secure location within the correct temperature range. We will provide further instructions as soon as the assessment is complete.

Thanks,

Alex Johnson
Clinical Research Associate
Denali Therapeutics
